name: Neural Adaptive Tomography (NeAT)
definition: NeAT is an adaptive, hierarchical neural rendering pipeline for multi-view inverse rendering, designed specifically for tomographic reconstruction of semi-transparent volumetric scenes. It combines an adaptive explicit octree representation with neural features in leaf nodes to achieve efficient reconstruction and self-calibration.
summary: Neural Adaptive Tomography is an adaptive, hierarchical neural rendering pipeline that reconstructs 3D density fields from X-ray images using an explicit sparse octree with implicit neural features in leaf nodes.
